response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC) AS position FROM compared WHERE share_difference > 0) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC;
